quickEntry.title: Quick entry
quickEntry.description: Type cards as a list — and check them before saving.

assistantHint.title: More than a list? Use the assistant
assistantHint.description: Recognizing a single card photo with AI or building a deck for you — the assistant does that (it needs an AI connection).

list.label: Card list
list.description: One card per line. Quantity, set code or passcode are detected automatically. Deck lists work too (YDK, ydke://, Omega code, recipe); headings such as “Monster” or “Extra” are skipped.
list.tooManyLines: {count} lines — please process at most {max} at a time.

file.button: Read an Excel or CSV file
file.hint: A table with the columns “Name”, “Quantity” and optionally “Set code” (.xlsx, .csv), or a text list. The cards appear below for review before anything is saved.
file.remaining: {count} line from the file is not in the review list yet. | {count} lines from the file are not in the review list yet.
file.skipped: {count} line without a card or quantity was skipped. | {count} lines without a card or quantity were skipped.
file.truncated: The file has more than {max} lines; the rest was not read.
file.queueFirst: Save the cards in the review list first, then load the next ones.
file.chooseDescription: Which sheet should be read? Nothing is saved yet.

errors.unsupported: This file format can't be read. Save the table in Excel as .xlsx or .csv.
errors.unreadable: The file couldn't be read. Is it a valid .xlsx or .csv file?
errors.tooLarge: The file is too large (at most 5 MB).
errors.noCards: No cards were found in the file. The table needs a “Name” column (and ideally “Quantity”).

photo.hint: Lay the cards next to each other in good light, with the name at the top of each card easy to read. Reading happens on your device (the photos are not uploaded), takes about a minute per photo and is an aid: check the cards below before anything is saved. Cards lying on their side are recognized; shiny foil and small photos are hard to read.

art.turning: Checking which way the photo lies …
art.scanning: Recognizing the cards by their artwork … {percent} %
art.matching: Comparing the pictures with all cards … {percent} %
art.refining: Taking a closer look at the matches … {percent} %

photo.unsure: {count} of them is uncertain. | {count} of them are uncertain.
photo.none: No cards were recognized in the photos. Try better light, get closer, and make sure the name at the top of each card is easy to read.

errors.tooMany: Please use at most {max} photos at a time.
errors.tooLarge: The photo “{name}” is too large (at most {max} MB).
errors.failed: The photos could not be read.
errors.offline: The recognition module could not be loaded. The first time needs an internet connection.

speech.hint: Say the cards with the quantity before the name, for example “three Blue-Eyes White Dragon, two Kuriboh”; a card you name twice is two copies. It is written down on your device.

quality.download: The first time, the speech model is loaded (about {size} MB).
quality.label: Accuracy
quality.slow: The accurate reading takes several times as long as the recording.

speech.noMicrophone: The microphone does not work on this page (only over HTTPS or in the desktop app). Choose a recording instead; on a phone this opens the voice recorder.
speech.nothing: Nothing was understood. Speak slowly and clearly, with the quantity before each card.

errors.denied: Access to the microphone was not allowed.
errors.failed: The recording could not be read.

queueFull.title: The review list is full
queueFull.description: The review list holds {max} lines — {dropped} line was not added. Save the existing lines first. | The review list holds {max} lines — {dropped} lines were not added. Save the existing lines first.

errors.title: That didn't work
errors.empty: Please enter at least one card first.
errors.tooManyLines: Please process at most {max} lines at a time.

defaults.title: Default collection
defaults.description: Applies to every line you don't pick a collection for.

review.title: Check and correct
review.nothingYet: Nothing to check yet — enter some cards as a list first.
review.unresolvedHint: Some lines are still open. Pick a match or remove the line to save everything.
review.nothingResolved: There are no resolved lines to save.

row.conflict: The set code and the name point to different cards — please pick one.
row.noSuggestions: No suggestions — please search the catalog.

justSaved.title: Just saved
justSaved.description: {count} copy is in your inventory now. You can move it to another collection without reading the list in again. | {count} copies are in your inventory now. You can move them to another collection without reading the list in again.
